steps.description: Type the text 'https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp' into the "Enter your MCP server URL" input field in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit extension for Visual Studio Code, shown in a modal prompt at the top of the interface.
Press the Enter key to confirm the MCP Server URL input field in the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit extension within Visual Studio Code.
Type 'None' into the Select Authentication Type quick pick to filter the None authentication option.
Press Enter to select the None authentication type for the MCP server.
Select all text in the Workspace Folder quick pick input to prepare to clear the leftover 'None' filter text carried over from the Select Authentication Type quick pick.
Press Backspace to delete the selected leftover 'None' filter text in the Workspace Folder quick pick so all workspace folder items become selectable again.
Press Enter to select the default workspace folder (/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects) in the Workspace Folder quick pick.

=== Generated Script ===
Language: bash

```bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects/${{var:app_name}}"
MCP_URL="https://learn.microsoft.com/api/mcp"

required_files=(
  "$PROJECT_DIR/appPackage/manifest.json"
  "$PROJECT_DIR/appPackage/declarativeAgent.json"
  "$PROJECT_DIR/appPackage/ai-plugin.json"
  "$PROJECT_DIR/m365agents.yml"
  "$PROJECT_DIR/.vscode/mcp.json"
)

for file in "${required_files[@]}"; do
  if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
    echo "Missing required file: $file" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

if [ -e "$PROJECT_DIR/appPackage/mcp-tools-1.json" ]; then
  echo "Unexpected static MCP tools file: $PROJECT_DIR/appPackage/mcp-tools-1.json" >&2
  exit 1
fi

PROJECT_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR" MCP_URL="$MCP_URL" python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

project_dir = Path(os.environ["PROJECT_DIR"])
mcp_url = os.environ["MCP_URL"]

ai_plugin = json.loads((project_dir / "appPackage" / "ai-plugin.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
if ai_plugin.get("functions") != []:
    raise AssertionError("ai-plugin.json functions must be empty for dynamic discovery.")

runtimes = ai_plugin.get("runtimes")
if not isinstance(runtimes, list) or len(runtimes) != 1:
    raise AssertionError("ai-plugin.json must contain exactly one runtime.")

runtime = runtimes[0]
if runtime.get("type") != "RemoteMCPServer":
    raise AssertionError("Runtime type must be RemoteMCPServer.")

spec = runtime.get("spec")
if not isinstance(spec, dict):
    raise AssertionError("Runtime spec must be an object.")
if spec.get("url") != mcp_url:
    raise AssertionError(f"Runtime spec URL mismatch: {spec.get('url')!r}")
if set(spec.keys()) != {"url"}:
    raise AssertionError(f"Runtime spec must contain only the MCP server URL: {spec!r}")
if "mcp_tool_description" in runtime:
    raise AssertionError("Runtime must not include mcp_tool_description.")

if runtime.get("run_for_functions") != ["*"]:
    raise AssertionError("Runtime run_for_functions must be ['*'].")
auth = runtime.get("auth")
if not isinstance(auth, dict) or auth.get("type") != "None":
    raise AssertionError("Runtime auth type must be None.")

da = json.loads((project_dir / "appPackage" / "declarativeAgent.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
actions = da.get("actions")
if not isinstance(actions, list) or not any(isinstance(action, dict) and action.get("id") == "action_1" and action.get("file") == "ai-plugin.json" for action in actions):
    raise AssertionError("declarativeAgent.json must reference action_1 -> ai-plugin.json.")

mcp = json.loads((project_dir / ".vscode" / "mcp.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
servers = mcp.get("servers")
if not isinstance(servers, dict) or not any(isinstance(server, dict) and server.get("type") == "http" and server.get("url") == mcp_url for server in servers.values()):
    raise AssertionError(".vscode/mcp.json must include an http server entry for the MCP URL.")

yml = (project_dir / "m365agents.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for forbidden in ("oauth/register", "dcr/register"):
    if forbidden in yml:
        raise AssertionError(f"None auth must not inject {forbidden}.")

print("Verified dynamic MCP project shape for None auth.")
PY
```
